target.comment: clinicalMetrics.respRate.50, unit: breaths/min. Percentiles available: .5, .50, .95, .max. Profile: https://bih-cei.github.io/T-CABS/StructureDefinition/t-cabs-observation-atemfrequenz-beatmet
clinicalMetrics.minuteVent.50, unit: L/min. Percentiles available: .5, .50, .95, .max. Profile: https://bih-cei.github.io/T-CABS/StructureDefinition/t-cabs-observation-amv

clinicalMetrics.leak.50, unit: L/s (NOTE: T-CABS uses L/min — unit conversion required). Percentiles: .5, .50, .95, .max. Profile: https://bih-cei.github.io/T-CABS/StructureDefinition/t-cabs-observation-leckage
clinicalMetrics.tgtIPAP.50, unit: cmH2O. Also available: peakInspiratoryPressure.50. Profile: https://bih-cei.github.io/T-CABS/StructureDefinition/t-cabs-observation-ipap
clinicalMetrics.tgtEPAP.50, unit: cmH2O. Also available: endExpiratoryPressure.50. Profile: https://bih-cei.github.io/T-CABS/StructureDefinition/t-cabs-observation-peep

clinicalMetrics.ieRatio.50, unit: ratio. AVX reports I:E ratio; IEEE target is Ti/Ttot (normalized). Profile: https://bih-cei.github.io/T-CABS/StructureDefinition/t-cabs-observation-atemzeitverhaeltnis

clinicalMetrics.tidalVol.50, unit: L (NOTE: T-CABS uses mL — unit conversion required). IEEE target is target/auto tidal volume. Profile: https://bih-cei.github.io/T-CABS/StructureDefinition/t-cabs-observation-targetvolume
respEvents.AHI, unit: events/hour. Additional indices available: HI, AI, OAI, CAI, UAI, ODI, CSR, RERA. Profile: https://bih-cei.github.io/T-CABS/StructureDefinition/t-cabs-observation-ahi
set.IPAP, unit: cmH2O. Also: set.maxIPAP. Profile: https://bih-cei.github.io/T-CABS/StructureDefinition/t-cabs-observation-ipap
set.EPAP, unit: cmH2O. Also: set.minEPAP, set.maxEPAP, set.startEPAP. Profile: https://bih-cei.github.io/T-CABS/StructureDefinition/t-cabs-observation-peep
set.respRate, unit: breaths/min. Stellar/Astral devices. Also: set.backupRate. Profile: https://bih-cei.github.io/T-CABS/StructureDefinition/t-cabs-observation-atemfrequenz-beatmet
set.Ti, unit: seconds. Stellar/Astral only. Also: set.tiMin, set.tiMax. Profile: https://bih-cei.github.io/T-CABS/StructureDefinition/t-cabs-observation-ti
set.tidalVolume, unit: mL. Also: set.safetyTidalVolume. Profile: https://bih-cei.github.io/T-CABS/StructureDefinition/t-cabs-observation-targetvolume
usage.duration, unit: minutes (per session). Also: totalUsageHoursOnDevice (cumulative hours). Maps to PoCD operating-hours Device extension.

name: ResMedToIEEE11073
title: ResMed AirView Exchange (AVX) API to IEEE 11073 Mapping
description: Maps ResMed AirView Exchange (AVX) REST API v4.38 parameter codes (Stellar/Astral/AirCurve 10 ST-A series) to IEEE 11073-10101 nomenclature codes used in T-CABS ventilation profiles. Source parameters come from clinicalMetrics, set (device settings), usage, and respEvents objects.
